title: Landloper content pack
description: Schema version 1. Validates a pack.json both as authored and after tooling has written derived fields: `position` and media dimensions are optional here, and required at ship time by the Stage 2a validator. Cross-field rules (realValue ordering, media cross-references) are not expressible in JSON Schema and live in src/content/positions.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the pack format. Bumped only by a breaking change to this schema.

id.description: Stable and unique across all packs. Never reused.

domainType.description: Label only. Never branched on in code.

locale.description: Metadata only in v1; no i18n machinery.

version.description: Semver, for the pack's own content.

coverImage.description: Must also appear in the media table.

scalingModel.description: The only legal value. Reserved so a future model needs no migration.

suggestedDistancesM.description: Journey distances offered in the setup flow, in metres.

media.description: Every asset in the pack, keyed by its relative path.

mediaRef.description: A relative path inside the pack folder. The pattern forbids a leading slash, a URL scheme, and any segment beginning with a dot, which rules out `..` traversal and hidden files.

type.description: "audio" is reserved and unused in v1.

caption.description: Displayed with the image; also serves as alt text.

width.description: Written by the media pipeline, not authored.

height.description: Written by the media pipeline, not authored.

bytes.description: Written by the media pipeline, not authored.

realValue.description: Authored position in realUnitLabel units. Non-decreasing across the array.

position.description: Derived, never authored. Written by the validator from realValue.

mediaRefs.description: Each must appear in the pack's media table.

notification.description: Fully authored strings. Code never assembles domain sentences or formats domain numbers.
